_comment: **Sold unwritten, and that is what makes buying twice worth doing.** A villager's offer is built once
and bought many times, so a word rolled by `given_item_modifiers` would be the word every copy carries.
The page carries the *stock* instead and the draw happens as it is taken
(`MerchantResultSlotMixin`), so each purchase is a different word.
Four or five of them at once, drawn afresh each time it is bought.
